hyperedges.label: App orchestrates all dashboard panels via hooks and renders them in layout
Cluster Topology, Super-Peer Election, and Bully Algorithm form the core P2P management pattern
useTopology, useHealth, useClusters all poll the API service and feed data upward to App

nodes.label: Vite Dev Proxy for Relay CORS Avoidance
nodes.rationale: In dev mode all /relay requests are proxied to https://mobicloud-relay-3.onrender.com to avoid CORS and browser tracking protection blocks; in prod VITE_RELAY_URL is used directly.
nodes.norm_label: vite dev proxy for relay cors avoidance

nodes.label: MobiCloud Relay Server (mobicloud-relay-3.onrender.com)
nodes.rationale: Single HA relay instance on Render.com; dashboard queries its REST metrics endpoints and SSE stream.

nodes.label: Canvas Particle Animation for Transfer Events
nodes.rationale: A requestAnimationFrame loop on an overlay canvas animates colored glowing dots along edges to visualise block, signal, and election transfers between nodes in real time.
nodes.norm_label: canvas particle animation for transfer events

nodes.label: Incremental Cytoscape Topology Update (no re-layout)
nodes.rationale: Topology diffs are applied incrementally: departed nodes are kept visible for 30 s with DEPART_TTL, edges are rebuilt only when active membership changes (mesh key), and cose-bilkent layout runs only once on first load to preserve user pan/zoom.

nodes.label: Super-Peer / Cluster Topology Visualisation
nodes.rationale: Super-peers are rendered as gold (yellow) compound-parent cluster nodes; regular members as blue dots. Full-mesh edges are drawn within each cluster to reflect the MobiCloud super-peer topology.

nodes.label: Short-Polling Pattern (setTimeout loop)
nodes.rationale: All data hooks (useTopology, useHealth, useLogs, useClusters) use a cancelled-flag + setTimeout loop instead of setInterval to avoid overlapping requests and ensure cleanup on unmount.

nodes.label: SSE Transfer Event Stream
nodes.rationale: Block/signal/election transfer events are pushed via SSE (/dashboard/events) so the GraphView2D can animate particles in real time without polling overhead.
